messages:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx and connection errors from inference fleet in us-east-1a (az1a). Error rate spiking to ~15% for generation routes. Auto-escalate to on-call.

sam: ack, I'm on it. starting triage — checking control plane + ENI/ENI-attach logs.

jordan: seeing a bunch of `ENI allocation failed` and `ipam: no addresses available` in infra logs. K/V cache misses spike too since many containers couldn't get outbound SNAT.

alex: confirm from VPC side — IPAM pool consumption hit 100% in az1a, recent scale-up of ephemeral hosts exhausted available addresses. AWS showing throttled ENI attaches.

sam: impact: inference requests from hosted nodes in az1a are failing to establish outbound connections (metadata / health checks), causing 5xx. Can we steer traffic out of az1a?

ryan: start traffic steering plan: reduce az1a weight to 0.2 in runtime router, shift remaining to az1b and eu-west-1. I'll open the routing change now. This will increase cross-AZ latency for some customers.

jordan: in parallel recommend enabling model-variant fallback (smaller quantized model) for canary traffic to reduce token compute and allow queue drain. Adding a short circuit breaker for hosts with >50% conn errors.

maria: PS teams — compile list of active customers with high QPS in az1a so we can notify. High-impact customers flagged: acme-corp, zoomedai, nimbus. Will prepare short status update for status.redwood.ai.

sam: runbook steps executed: 1) router weights updated (ryan) 2) autoscaler paused for ephemeral pool 3) trigger IPAM reclamation job to free stale addresses (`/scripts/ipam-reclaim --age=5m`) 4) enable fallback model (jordan).

jordan: pushing fallback rollout: `PATCH /v1/rollouts {"route":"/generate","fallback":"gpt-small-quant-v2"}` — rolling to 10% -> 50% -> 100% for affected routes. Expect lower latencies per token but slightly lower quality.

alex: AWS side: raised a support case for ENI attach throttle; meanwhile we can add ephemeral ENI pool from az1b to attach in cross-az mode (requires a config flip). Initiating cross-az attach as temporary workaround.

neha: taking next on-call in 20m. Sam, please handoff notes + current state. Any outstanding tasks?

sam: handoff: routing weight lowered, ipam reclaim running (30% done), fallback models at 40% traffic, customers notified draft ready, AWS case opened (case# 12345678). Watch error rate and p95 latency.

deploy-bot: DNS: no changes detected. Health-checker: 85% healthy targets in az1a (was 98% before).

ryan: customer impact: brief SLO breach for generation p99 for ~12 minutes for some tenants. Maria to post status update now.

maria: posted status update: "Partial service degradation affecting some generation requests in us-east-1a. Traffic being shifted while we mitigate. No data exposure. Working on restoration."

jordan: monitoring: 5xx rate down from 15% -> 3% after routing shift and fallback. KVCACHE build errors reduced. Still seeing occasional metadata timeouts from hosts that lost SNAT.

alex: IPAM reclaim finished, freed ~1200 addresses. ENI attach throttles cleared per AWS console, attaching more ephemerals to recovered hosts.

sam: recommend leaving fallback in place 30m, then gradually increase az1a weight if errors stay low. neha, you have the handoff.

neha: taking it. I'll monitor next 2 hours, escalate if >5% 5xx persists. Thanks team — file post-incident ticket for follow-up: root cause = IPAM pool exhaustion + rapid ephemeral host scale, action items: IPAM headroom alert, cap ephemeral scale, pre-warm ENIs.

incident-bot: Incident in `incidents` channel updated to "mitigated" at 1829993600.
